footer.howItWorks: 5 questions per session when you pick a subject (today's mission combines 15: 3 from each) · Questions you get right won't repeat until you've done them all · Wrong answers come back for extra practice
footer.privacy: The child's progress is saved on this device. The adult account (optional) is saved in the cloud. See the privacy policy in Settings.
footer.contentOrigin: Original questions, based on the official primary-school curriculum. No publisher's material is used.
